about_short_description.short_description: Afternoon.co empowers founders with real-time financial metrics and automated bookkeeping, reducing administrative tasks for brands.

product.name: Bookkeeping Services
product.description: Provides bookkeeping including monthly financial statements, expense tracking, invoicing, and payments to keep financial records up to date.

product.name: Year-End and Quarterly Tax Filing
product.description: Handles year-end tax filing, quarterly estimated tax calculations, and tax deduction optimization for businesses without a CPA.

product.name: Sales Tax Automation
product.description: Automates calculation, filing, and remittance of sales tax across all US states, including nexus monitoring and audit support.

product.name: Government Compliance and Mail Automation
product.description: Automates government communications, filings, LLC renewals, annual reports, and manages compliance calendars to avoid missed deadlines.
